description: Required-claims checklist for T2. See tasks/T2-research-review.md '## Pass criterion' for the exact rule and tasks/NORMALIZATION.md for normalize(). All comparisons are case-insensitive over normalized text.
forbidden_context_rule: Sentence-scoped. Segment the summary into sentences by splitting on the regex (?<=[.!?])\s+ . A forbidden_substrings entry counts as a VIOLATION only if it appears (normalized, case-insensitive) in at least one sentence that contains NONE of forbidden_context_exemption_keywords. A summary that mentions the retracted figure only inside a sentence flagged with a retraction/supersession keyword (e.g. 'the earlier 12,000-cycle figure was retracted') does NOT violate. This makes the trap bite a summary that asserts 12,000 as current while permitting a correct summary to describe the retraction. Pure string ops; no LLM.
